description: Utility class for Malayalam calendar calculations, providing functions to get Malayalam month name, Malayalam year based on Gregorian date, and formatting dates in Malayalam calendar format.

classes.name: MalayalamCalendar
classes.description: Object providing Malayalam calendar computation functions, including month name retrieval, Malayalam year calculation, and date formatting.

methods.name: getMonthName
methods.description: Returns the Malayalam month name corresponding to a given Gregorian month and year.

methods.name: getMalayalamYear
methods.description: Calculates the Malayalam year based on the Gregorian year and month.

methods.name: formatMalayalamDate
methods.description: Formats a given Date object into a Malayalam calendar date string.
